|-

== Type 1: Spawn pattern from character ==
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; margin:auto; vertical-align:top; min-width:280px; width:{{{width|80}}}%;"
|-
! scope="row"| No.
| Which pattern to spawn. Corresponds to the pattern ID.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| Relative X position to the pattern spawning the effect.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Relative Y position to the pattern spawning the effect.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 3
| Flagset 1:
*'''Bit 0 [1]:''' Remove when parent gets hit (incl. shield, throw and throw tech). (same as applying _ObjFlags_EraseParentDamage)
*'''Bit 1 [2]:''' Unused.
*'''Bit 2 [4]:''' Follow parent position. (same as applying _ObjFlags_ParentMove)
*'''Bit 3 [8]:''' Affected by hitstop affecting parent.
*'''Bit 4 [16]:''' Spawns at center of camera.
*'''Bit 5 [32]:''' Removed on parent pattern change. (same as applying _ObjFlags_EraseParentPatChange)
*'''Bit 6 [64]:''' Can go below floor level (same as applying _ObjFlags_NoGround)
*'''Bit 7 [128]:''' Always spawns on floor.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 4
| Flagset 2:
*'''Bit 0 [1]:''' Unused.
*'''Bit 1 [2]:''' Follow parent position.
*'''Bit 2 [4]:''' Remove when parent gets thrown.
*'''Bit 3 [8]:''' Unused.
*'''Bit 4 [16]:''' Unused.
*'''Bit 5 [32]:''' Unused.
*'''Bit 6 [64]:''' Doesn't freeze on super flash. (same as applying _ObjFlags_MoveTimeStop)
*'''Bit 7 [128]:''' Doesn't move with camera. (same as applying _ObjFlags_NoCamera)
*'''Bit 8 [256]:''' Position relative to opponent.
*'''Bit 9 [512]:''' Spawns at position near center of stage.
*'''Bit 10 [1024]:''' Spawns at position near center of stage, always faces right.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 8
| Angle (same as using method SetAngle)
|}

== Type 4: Set Opponent Visual State (on Grab) ==
'''Note: This type is succeeded by Type 14.'''
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; margin:auto; vertical-align:top; min-width:280px; width:{{{width|80}}}%;"
|-
! scope="row"| No.
| Pattern to set the opponent to. Use hitstun patterns.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| Relative X position.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Relative Y position.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 4
| Flagset 1:
*'''Bit 0 [1]:''' Play animation.
*'''Bit 1 [2]:''' Reverse vector.
*'''Bit 3 [8]:''' Can't otg.
*'''Bit 5 [32]:''' Force hard knockdown.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 5
| Set vector. Only applies when Param 4 bit 0 is applied.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 6
| Set untech time. 0 = infinite.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 8
| Set frame of animation, of pattern, of opponent.
|}

== Type 6: Character and Screen Modifier ==
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; margin:auto; vertical-align:top; min-width:280px; width:{{{width|80}}}%;"
|-
!rowspan="2"| No. 1 !!colspan="2"| Vertical Screenshake
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
|Duration of screenshake.
|-
!rowspan="2"| No. 2 !!colspan="2"| Ticker Text Display
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
|Display INVICIBILITY text. Set to 100 or higher to toggle.
|-
!rowspan="2"| No. 5 !!colspan="5"|  Round Recover 1 (wip)
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
|Init
|-
! No. 6 !!colspan="2"|  Locks pattern horizontal movement.
|-
! No. 8 !!colspan="2"|  Locks pattern vertical movement.
|-
!rowspan="4"| No. 12 !!colspan="2"| Pattern position modifier
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| Horizontal position modifier.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Vertical position modifier.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 3
| Moves to the ground, towards the opponent. Unknown what exactly this value does.
|-
!rowspan="4"| No. 111 !!colspan="2"| Movement Vector Freeze
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| End freeze.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Start freeze.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 3
| Y speed set after freeze.
|-
!rowspan="1"| No. 255 !!colspan="2"| Round Recover End (wip)
|-
|}

== Type 9: Play sound ==
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; margin:auto; vertical-align:top; min-width:280px; width:{{{width|80}}}%;"
|-
! scope="row"| No.
| Set sound bank (0 = universal sounds <code>se\normal_se.txt</code>, 1 = character sounds <code>data\chrXXX\chrXXX_se_list.txt</code>)
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| Sound ID.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Probability of playing sound (0 = 100%)
|-
! scope="row"| Param 3
| Number of different sounds to play. 1 and 0 are equivalent. IDs adjacent.
|}

== Type 14: Set Opponent Visual State 2 (on Grab) ==
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; margin:auto; vertical-align:top; min-width:280px; width:{{{width|80}}}%;"
|-
! scope="row"| No.
| Pattern to set the opponent to. Use hitstun patterns.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 1
| Relative X position. Only settable once per pattern.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 2
| Relative Y position. Only settable once per pattern.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 3
| Rotation value.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 4
| Set vector ID.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 5
| Grab position anchor. 
0 = Position origin
1-3 = Special box 10 - 12
|-
! scope="row"| Param 6
| Set untech time.
|-
! scope="row"| Param 7
| Set grab hold position.
*'''Bit 0 [1]:''' Force player to opponent's location.
*'''Bit 1 [2]:''' Force opponent to player's location.
|}
